#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Duplicate the last two slides of a PPTX file, append copies preserving order."""
import copy
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
from lxml import etree

SRC = "/home/user/Desktop/MLA_Workshop_061X_Works_Cited.pptx"
DST = SRC

prs = Presentation(SRC)
n = len(prs.slides)
print(f"Original slide count: {n}")

# Identify the last two slides (A = n-2, B = n-1 in 0-index)
slide_a = prs.slides[n - 2]
slide_b = prs.slides[n - 1]

def duplicate_slide(prs, source_slide):
    """Append a duplicate of source_slide to the end of the presentation."""
    # Create a new blank slide using the source slide's layout
    blank_layout = source_slide.slide_layout
    new_slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)

    # Remove all shapes auto-added by the layout placeholders so we start clean
    # (We'll copy the source slide's spTree contents directly)
    # Get the spTree elements of both slides
    src_spTree = source_slide.shapes._spTree
    dst_spTree = new_slide.shapes._spTree

    # Remove all child shapes from new slide (keep nvGrpSpPr and grpSpPr)
    keep_tags = {qn('p:nvGrpSpPr'), qn('p:grpSpPr')}
    for child in list(dst_spTree):
        if child.tag not in keep_tags:
            dst_spTree.remove(child)

    # Copy each shape element from source to destination
    for child in src_spTree:
        if child.tag in keep_tags:
            continue
        new_el = copy.deepcopy(child)
        dst_spTree.append(new_el)

    # Copy slide-level properties: background, transition, timing
    src_xml = source_slide._element
    dst_xml = new_slide._element

    # Copy <p:bg> if present (inside cSld)
    src_cSld = src_xml.find(qn('p:cSld'))
    dst_cSld = dst_xml.find(qn('p:cSld'))
    if src_cSld is not None and dst_cSld is not None:
        src_bg = src_cSld.find(qn('p:bg'))
        if src_bg is not None:
            # Remove existing bg in dst if any
            existing_bg = dst_cSld.find(qn('p:bg'))
            if existing_bg is not None:
                dst_cSld.remove(existing_bg)
            # Insert bg as the first child of cSld (correct position per schema)
            dst_cSld.insert(0, copy.deepcopy(src_bg))

    # Copy transition <p:transition>
    src_trans = src_xml.find(qn('p:transition'))
    if src_trans is not None:
        existing_trans = dst_xml.find(qn('p:transition'))
        if existing_trans is not None:
            dst_xml.remove(existing_trans)
        dst_xml.append(copy.deepcopy(src_trans))

    # Copy timing <p:timing>
    src_timing = src_xml.find(qn('p:timing'))
    if src_timing is not None:
        existing_timing = dst_xml.find(qn('p:timing'))
        if existing_timing is not None:
            dst_xml.remove(existing_timing)
        dst_xml.append(copy.deepcopy(src_timing))

    # Copy any image / media relationships from source slide
    # so embedded pictures continue to resolve
    src_part = source_slide.part
    dst_part = new_slide.part
    # Build a map of old rId -> new rId for relationships we copy
    rel_map = {}
    for rel_id, rel in src_part.rels.items():
        # Skip slideLayout rel (already handled by add_slide) and notesSlide
        if rel.reltype.endswith('/slideLayout'):
            continue
        if rel.reltype.endswith('/notesSlide'):
            continue
        if rel.is_external:
            new_rid = dst_part.relate_to(rel.target_ref, rel.reltype, is_external=True)
        else:
            new_rid = dst_part.relate_to(rel.target_part, rel.reltype)
        rel_map[rel_id] = new_rid

    # Update r:embed / r:link / r:id references in the copied shapes
    if rel_map:
        ns_r = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'
        for el in dst_spTree.iter():
            for attr in (f'{{{ns_r}}}embed', f'{{{ns_r}}}link', f'{{{ns_r}}}id'):
                val = el.get(attr)
                if val and val in rel_map:
                    el.set(attr, rel_map[val])

    return new_slide

dup_a = duplicate_slide(prs, slide_a)
dup_b = duplicate_slide(prs, slide_b)

print(f"New slide count: {len(prs.slides)}")
prs.save(DST)
print(f"Saved to {DST}")
